title: A Novel Xenograft Bone Substitute Supports Stable Bone Formation in Circumferential Defects Around Dental Implants in Minipigs
authors: Catros S, Sandgren R, Pippenger BE, Fricain JC, Herber V, El Chaar E. Int J Oral Maxillofac Implants. 2020 Nov/Dec;35(6):1122-1131. doi: 10.11607/jomi.8265.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The results of this study indicate that test and control materials both represent viable bovine bone graft material that equivalently support the formation of new and stable bone volume specifically when used for simultaneous augmentation around implants” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
